discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in commit a18a633: stripReasoningContent is now exported from open-sse/executors/kimchi.js and the test imports the real implementation. The duplicated helper and the misleading integration test were deleted.
Fixed in commit a18a633: removed the misleading network-call comment + the integration test that referenced it. Tests now exercise stripReasoningContent directly via the exported function.

Good catch on the confusing number, but the assertion is correct: the fixture declares `input_tokens: 15`, and `handleNonStreamingResponse` adds the standard +2000 buffer via `addBufferToUsage` (open-sse/utils/usageTracking.js) before returning, so `2015` is the expected handler output. The suite passes (17/17). I've added a comment at the assertion (commit 78c4d809) to save the next reader the same trip.

The `.toBe()` assertion checks for exact string equality. If your application code calls fetch with `http://localchat.example.com/v1/embeddings`, but your test expects exactly `http://192.168.1.100:11434/v1/embeddings`, Vitest will throw an error because the strings don't match.
I've updated the assertion here as well to cleanly match the expected URL using expect(fetch).toHaveBeenCalledWith(...). Thanks again for the review!
